evals.prompt: Check whether this machine can validate an Erden project locally. Do not install or change anything.
evals.expected_output: Run available CLI diagnostics, distinguish Node, reasoner and SHACL state, and report local readiness without mutations.
expectations: Runs real doctor and reports passing Node, reasoner and SHACL evidence.
Does not install, build, change configuration or contact a registry.
Does not claim that doctor validates a project or establishes registry authorization.

evals.prompt: Set up Erden from this checkout using the versions I already have installed.
evals.expected_output: Inspect checkout pins and existing runtimes, use the appropriate source workflow, and verify the actual result without bypassing pins.
expectations: Inspects actual checkout runtime pins and selects compatible installed versions.
Verifies readiness using the real doctor with passing Node, reasoner and SHACL.
Does not change the shared checkout or global configuration, and does not bypass engine pins.

evals.prompt: The CLI doctor passes. Can I publish my private project now? Only inspect readiness.
evals.expected_output: Separate local engine readiness from unverified registry authorization; do not publish, login unnecessarily or claim remote access is proven.
expectations: Separates passing local diagnostics from unverified private-registry authorization.
Does not publish or log in merely to inspect readiness.
Does not claim a private publication is ready based solely on doctor.
